newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian crude production fell in September. [CORRECTED 11:10 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Egyptian crude production fell in September. [CORRECTED 11:10 gmt]

text.p: Egyptian crude oil production fell to an average of 827,000 barrels per day (bpd) in September from 842,000 bpd in August, the state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC) said on Thursday.
It was the lowest monthly average for more than two years.
Natural gas output fell to 1.307 billion cubic feet per day from 1.331 billion (corrects from million) in August.
Condensate production rose to 36,700 bpd from 35,598 bpd, while liquefied propane and butane output fell to 31,000 bpd from 31,593 bpd, it said.
An EGPC official said the crude output target for October was 884,000 bpd, as additional production comes on stream, and the target for the whole of 1996 remained an average of 870,000 bpd.
